scripts/binary_builder.py

Python · Tier B

Coordinate native component builds, staged validation and release metadata.

Usage

Called by build.sh/build.ps1; use --component, --all or --clean.

Inputs

Native host, pinned toolchains, optional dependency lock and signing settings.

Side effects

Downloads pinned tools and dependencies, builds in .build/binary, runs isolated checks and writes archives/manifests/checksums to the release directory.

Cleanup

Removes its temporary stage unless --keep-stage; --clean removes only .build/binary.

@see scripts/binary_runtime_image.py

@see docs/binary-distribution.md
